description.p: utmps is an implementation of the utmpx.h family of functions, which record who is logged in. The files utmp and wtmp are only written by two small daemons, which check what a program may change, and the library talks to them. The C library of musl has these functions as stubs that do nothing.

This package contains the development files. The headers are in include/utmps and take the place of utmpx.h and utmp.h of the C library for a program that is built with the flags that pkg-config gives for libutmps.
